headline: Frequent Reworks in Template Execution Logic
diagnosis: The file exec.go is undergoing repeated modifications primarily due to issues with template execution, particularly around variable handling and depth management. The commit messages indicate a pattern of fixes related to variable types and synchronization with upstream Go templates, suggesting instability in the execution logic.
plan: Conduct a thorough review of the state management logic, particularly the push, pop, and setVar methods, to identify potential bugs or edge cases causing the need for frequent fixes.
Establish a comprehensive set of unit tests focused on variable handling and execution depth to catch issues early and reduce the need for rework.
Investigate the impact of recent upgrades to Go versions on the execution logic, ensuring compatibility and stability with the latest changes.
Document the known issues and resolutions in the codebase to provide context for future developers and reduce the likelihood of repeated fixes.
owner_hint: Only one author is responsible for changes, indicating a high bus factor.
